prose.intro: Parallel Aggressor is an audio plugin built around parallel processing. It splits a signal into Dry, Spank, and Heat paths for blended original, heavily compressed, and heavily saturated sound.
prose.sound: The Dry path retains the original signal, while Spank adds a heavily compressed duplicate and Heat adds a heavily saturated duplicate. Blending the three equal parts can add punch and a bigger mix sound without processing one track alone.
prose.audience: For tracks needing more punch in a mix.

Cherry Audio Atomika.overview: Atomika is Cherry Audio's painstakingly crafted emulation of the Polivoks synthesizer manufactured at the Formanta Radio Factory between 1982 and 1990. Featuring the circuit-modeled DSP designs of award-winning developer Mark Barton, Atomika goes far beyond duplicating the notorious Soviet synth.

prose.intro: Atomika is a virtual analog emulation of the 1980s Soviet Polivoks synthesizer, expanded with 16-voice polyphony, effects, and an arpeggiator. Its programmable op-amp filter adds Starve, Filter Drive, Amp Drive, highpass, notch, and peak responses.
prose.sound: The programmable op-amp filter gives the signal a distinctive, gritty character. prose.audience: It suits synth players who want polyphonic parts, detunable unison, chord memory, and tempo-synced arpeggios. It fits material that calls for wide stereo ensemble, tape echo, and plate or hall reverb depth.

prose.intro: Novachord + Solovox is a two-instrument bundle based on early electronic keyboards. It combines 32-voice synthesized polyphony with a monophonic keyboard attachment for organ-style leads.

Cherry Audio PS 3300.overview: PS-3300 is an exactingly faithful virtual analog emulation of the colossal and ultra-rare semi-modular analog polyphonic synthesizer released by Korg in 1977.

prose.intro: PS 3300 is a virtual analog emulation of a 1977 semi-modular polyphonic synthesizer. Its three independent signal-generator panels combine oscillators, filters, resonators, envelopes, amplifiers, and modulation generators.
prose.sound: Three-peak resonators create vowel-like and phasing tones, while three stacked generator panels build broad, layered timbres. The clean PS lowpass filter and crunchier MS-style filter alter the edge of each voice, with chorus, syncable echo, and spring, plate, or Galactic reverb adding space. Dual modulation generators, sample & hold, and per-note tuning support timbres that evolve over time.
prose.audience: It suits keyboard players who need up to 24 voices of polyphony and independent articulation across 48 keys. It also suits sound designers building patches with virtual cables, resonators, modulation, and alternate temperaments.

Cherry Audio Sines Synthesizer.overview: Sines is a sensational and innovative original polyphonic synthesiser. Employing four sine-wave oscillators, Sines utilises diverse waveshaping methods to bend these basic waves into infinitely variable and complex shapes.

prose.intro: Sines is an original polyphonic synthesiser with four independent sine waveform oscillators. Six waveshaper controls bend basic waves into standard and complex shapes.
prose.sound: Four sine-wave oscillators use feedback, phase, width, shape, wavefold, and drive to bend basic waves into sawtooth, square, pulse, triangle, and more complex, novel shapes. Four tempo-syncable LFOs, auxiliary envelope generators, and a four-slot mod matrix modulate nearly every parameter, while distortion, sample-crushing, delay, and five reverb effects create timbres ranging from sublime to sizzling.
prose.audience: For MPE-compatible controllers, Sines supports Pitch, Channel Pressure, and Timbre for more organic and expressive performances.

Cherry Audio Yellowjacket.overview: Yellowjacket synthesizer is a stunning value-packed tribute to the venerable Wasp synthesizer, released by the British synth company EDP in 1978. Cherry Audio has reproduced the singular buzzy tone and drone of this legendary monophonic, digital/analog hybrid, from its quirky oscillators to its distinctive filter.

prose.intro: Yellowjacket is a synthesizer modeled on the 1978 EDP Wasp, with two oscillators, a multimode filter, and up to 16 voices. Its Multi voice modes add three adjustable mini synth panels for per-note variation.
prose.sound: Two distinct oscillators with ramp, pulse, square, and modulated pulse-wave forms shape the singular buzzy tone and drone. A two-pole 12dB state-variable filter offers lowpass, bandpass, highpass, and notch modes, while the mono speaker effect adds hiss and hum for a lo-fi tone.
prose.audience: It suits users creating sizzling Leads, sublime Arps, atmospheric Pads, single-fingered Chords, stunning Strings, deep Basses, and varied patterns with the touch of a single key.

Continuum.overview: There are hundreds of delay plugins out there, so why try another? Because most delays simply repeat the past, while Continuum feels it. Eventide H910 Harmonizer.overview: The H910 Harmonizer was the world’s first digital effects processor. With its unique combinations of pitch shifting, modulation and delay, the H910 can be heard on countless ground-breaking works by artists from AC/DC to David Bowie to Frank Zappa. Simply put, nothing sounds quite like it.

prose.sound: Pitch changes create musical intervals, harmonies, guitar spread, snare weight, and organic synth detuning. Slap-back delays add vocal echoes, while self-oscillation, delay, and anti-feedback produce mechanical sounds, drones, robot language, and feedback chaos. Nonlinear electronics modeling brings grit and juiciness to the signal.
prose.audience: It suits producers and engineers shaping vocals, guitars, snares, synths, and solo instruments. Use it for harmonies, doubling, slap-back echoes, stereo sound, pitch-controlled effects, and experimental drones.

lineage.phrase: as a full-featured plug-in
lineage.evidence: The same legendary effects processor used by Jimmy Page, and cherished by Suzanne Ciani, has been faithfully recreated as a full-featured plug-in.

Eventide H949 Harmonizer.overview: Building on the legacy of the H910 pitch shifter, the H949 Harmonizer® was Eventide’s first de-glitched pitch-shifter. Produced from 1979-1984, it introduced the MicroPitch effect, which used a proprietary single-sideband modulation technique for precise control of small pitch shifts.

prose.sound: MicroPitch creates an authentic double-tracked vocal character that is more natural and less identical to the original. Reverse plays short signal segments backward, while feedback around reversed, delayed, and pitch-changed segments produces new sounds. Flange combines varying delay with the original signal for frequency cancellations.
prose.audience: It suits engineers shaping doubled vocals with small pitch changes and random delay. It also fits material needing stereo widening, reverse segments, flange, or randomized pitching effects.

MicroPitch is the latest incarnation of an iconic effect originated by Eventide in the 1970s. With each generation, Eventide has added refined, enhanced and built-on it's legendary predecessors.

prose.intro: MicroPitch is a dual-voice pitch shifter with delays for subtle tone fattening and slapback effects. Its two voices shift from unison to −50 cents and +50 cents, each with up to two seconds of delay.

prose.intro: Pro-R 2 is a professional reverb plug-in with immersive audio support up to 9.1.6 Dolby Atmos. Its Decay Rate EQ shapes reverb decay across the frequency spectrum with parametric EQ bands.
prose.sound: Its core room sound is clean and natural, with Space moving from tiny boxes to vast arenas while matching decay time to the selected room model. Thickness adds program-dependent density, saturation, and compression; Ducking lowers the wet signal while the dry signal is present.
prose.audience: It suits drums and vocals needing plate reverb, and mixes needing long, bright hyper-real spatial ambiences.

FabFilter Timeless 3.overview: FabFilter Timeless 3 is a versatile, vintage-sounding tape delay, which will fully satisfy your everyday delay needs. GForce impOSCar3.overview: At the heart of GForce's impOSCar3 lies the design of the legendary British hardware synth OSCar®. Like the original, its hybrid architecture combines the precision of digital oscillators with the warmth of analogue filters, providing a wide range of sonic possibilities.

prose.intro: ImpOSCar3 is an emulation of the British OSCar synthesizer, combining digital oscillators with analogue filters. Its distinctive dual filter offers nine modes and parallel LP, HP, and BP configurations.
prose.sound: Digital oscillators meet analogue filters for digital clarity and analogue richness. The filters shape formant-like textures, phasing, and resonance effects, while poly-unison builds a wall of sound. Wavetables, Drive, Cutoff, Q, and Separation extend the palette toward lush, dark, and ambient tones.
prose.audience: It suits synth players and sound designers creating pads, resonant bells, precise leads, bass, and house material. The wavetable editor and user LFO support custom patch design and modulation work.

prose.audience: For long-time Oberheim fans and those new to SEM-based synthesis.

PITCHMAP.overview: PITCHMAP is the world's first and only plug-in that allows processing the pitch of individual sounds within mixed signals in real-time.

prose.audience: It suits engineers correcting tuning in mixed recordings, composers testing harmonies, and producers working with sampled material. It also fits DJs, sound designers, mash-up artists, and remixers adapting keys, scales, and components.
prose.intro: PITCHMAP processes the pitch of individual sounds within mixed signals in real time. MIDI control can change melodies and harmonies in a recording while retaining transient crispness in percussive elements.
prose.sound: Full mixes and complex polyphonic signals can be tuned or have their pitches changed in real time under MIDI control. Percussive elements retain transient crispness while melodies, harmonies, and individual sounds within a mix are changed. Advanced synthesizer-like sound transformations create far-out sounds from audio.

Relooper.overview: Tired of staring at the same static loops? Relooper instantly transforms your existing audio into fresh, syncopated grooves and glitchy remixes in real-time.

prose.intro: Relooper is a real-time groove processor that generates new groove layers from incoming audio and mixes two of them with the original loop. Its groove engine replays buffered slices at different speeds, directions, positions, and lengths.
prose.sound: Incoming loops can stutter, repeat, rearrange, repitch, reverse, and glitch as Relooper reshapes their slices in real time. The two generated layers can be morphed, processed with distortion, reverb, SFX, modulation, or sweeping filters, then blended with the original loop. Level modulation can create end-of-bar auto-fills, trance-gate rhythms, and sidechain-style pumping.
prose.audience: It suits producers working with loops and simple beats who want rhythmic auto-fills, trance-gate rhythms, or sidechain-style pumping effects.

SSL Native X-Phase.overview: X-Phase is an All-pass Filter plug-in that offers the user manual control and high-quality response. It enables the user to apply a phase shift (sometimes called a phase offset) at a specified frequency within a signal.

prose.intro: SSL Native X-Phase is an all-pass filter plug-in for frequency-specific phase control. Gain remains unchanged throughout the signal while phase shift is applied at a specified frequency.
prose.sound: Frequency and Q controls set the frequency and slope of phase correction across the signal. A phase-invert button flips the filter phase 180 degrees, while the separate Delay section applies broader time alignment in seconds, milliseconds, samples, metres, or feet.
prose.audience: It suits microphone recording with overheads and close mics causing phase problems when mixed. It also suits comb-filter creation by applying a filtered signal to an unfiltered version of the same signal.

Sonible smart gate.overview: smart:gate is the answer to reliable gating. The plug-in automatically detects the presence of a chosen target source (e.g. vocals, keys, kick) and allows to focus on this source when gating.

prose.intro: Smart:gate is a content-aware gate that detects a selected target source rather than reacting to the overall input level. Its distinctive feature is target-focused gating that can keep working when competing signals are louder.
prose.sound: The gate responds to signal components belonging to the selected target, helping vocals, keys, kick, electric guitar, or piano remain the focus while other material is suppressed. Level Bias can make its response follow drums more closely or keep vocals more natural, while three-band suppression weights the action across the frequency spectrum. Ducking mode reduces the selected target instead of passing it through.
prose.audience: It suits mixers working with vocals, drums, kick, keys, electric guitar, or piano in sessions where source levels vary or competing instruments overlap. It also fits users who want conventional gating through the No Target mode.

Soundtoys Devil-Loc Deluxe.overview: To take things beyond the hardware that inspired it and give you even more creative flexibility, Soundtoys created a deluxe version of the Devil-Loc plug-in, Devil-Loc Deluxe.

prose.intro: Devil-Loc Deluxe is a compression plugin built on the design of the Shure Level-Loc brick wall limiter, adding a Darkness tone control, switchable fast and slow release times, and a mix knob for blending dry signal back in.
prose.sound: The compression is extreme and gritty, dark, dirty, and unusual, making drums gigantic and nasty and thundering. Dark thundering drums, driven lo-fi loops, and sizzle on vocals or acoustic guitar all come from this extreme effect, while the Darkness control rolls off crunchy highs for a warmer tone. The mix knob dials in grit and ambience, and fast or slow release times add further variety and control.
prose.audience: Drums, room mics, vocals, and acoustic guitar all suit this extreme effect, along with dark thundering drums and driven lo-fi loops. The mix knob keeps dry signal in reach, so small amounts of grit and sizzle also suit vocals or acoustic guitar.

Soundtoys PrimalTap.overview: Whether you’re looking for a studio delay that’s full of 80s characters, or a performance tool that responds to knob tweaking with mind-bending sounds, PrimalTap is a must!

prose.intro: PrimalTap is a digital delay plugin that emulates the sound and features of the classic Prime Time delay, known for its gritty, lo-fi character and unique modulation capabilities.
prose.sound: PrimalTap combines digital and analog qualities to deliver a gritty, textured delay with a lo-fi edge. The Multiply control allows for pitch shifts and sample rate reduction, creating unusual echoes and warped sounds. The VCO section adds modulation, enabling effects like chorusing, flanging, and robotic ring modulation.

Soundtoys Sie Q.overview: In Soundtoys' quest to capture unique tones and colours from the world of hardware, Soundtoys dug deep into the Soundtoys gear museum and found a little-known gem: the Siemens W295b. It impressed us so much that it became the inspiration for Soundtoys' first EQ.

prose.sound: Sie-Q delivers an airy top end that adds space and openness to any track, making vocals sound more present and acoustic instruments feel more detailed. Its smooth frequency response allows for precise shaping without harshness, and its saturation character can be pushed to recreate the warm, analog tone of the original hardware.

driveDAT.overview: driveDAT is a saturation and degradation effect built around one piece of hardware behaviour: a DAT recorder being fed a signal that is too loud for it. Hiss that breathes with the programme, an input stage that squashes, and a converter that runs out of numbers, arranged in the order the deck did it.

prose.sound: The sound is defined by a converter with a hard ceiling and an analogue front end with limited headroom, resulting in a signal that is clipped and flattened at the top end. The input stage limits both signal and hiss together, creating a hiss that breathes with the programme and distorts out of the way when the programme is loud.
